name: DestinationMaker: Tourism Destination Management
description: Lead the Agencia de Turismo de Valdesol, a Destination Management Organization in a fictional LATAM coastal region. Over three years, make strategic decisions on marketing segmentation, experience infrastructure, and sustainability to build a competitive, profitable, and community-friendly tourism destination. Balance visitor revenue growth with satisfaction, environmental stewardship, and community benefit on a balanced scorecard.

Year 1: Marketing and Segmentation Strategy

Allocate your $9M marketing budget across channels and choose your brand positioning. Channel percentages for Digital, OTA, and PR must total 100% or less; the remainder goes to airline partnerships and traditional media.

Channel allocation: 90% — remainder to airline partnerships + traditional media

Year 2: Experience and Infrastructure Investment

Allocate your $6M capital budget across experience categories (must total 100% or less). Then set your commercialization intensity: low values preserve authenticity, high values optimize for visitor volume.

1 = Community-Centric 5 10 = Volume-Optimized
Capex allocation: 100% of $6M budget

Year 3: Sustainability and Community Benefit

Set carrying capacity limits, share revenue with communities, invest in sustainability certifications, and plan expansion into underutilized areas. Certification and expansion budgets must total 30% or less of your $15M budget.

Current baseline: ~3,300/day. Infrastructure handles ~5,500 without congestion.
Higher share strengthens social license; lower share maximizes short-term profit.
